artworks.title: The Pier with a Lamp
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, and burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vaulted interior architectural space. The scene features grand arches, intricately carved stone elements, a central prominent structure, and detailed bases adorned with figures and decorative ring motifs. Shading and cross-hatching add texture and depth. The overall scene conveys a feeling of historical and monumental architecture.

artworks.title: The Pier with Chains
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with grand arches and columns. The scene shows intricate architectural space with arches, columns, hanging lanterns, stairs, pathways, shadowed corners, and warmly lit spaces. The lines and crosshatching create texture and depth, suggesting aged, possibly stone construction. The contrast between dark and light areas conveys depth and drama.

artworks.title: Concours pour le Prix de l'Etude des Têtes et de l'Expression (Contest for the Prize for the Study of Heads and Expression)
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques Flipart after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a chair, surrounded by three men who are sketching her. There are additional men seated to the right, some holding canes. The room's walls are filled with framed drawings and sketches, creating an atmosphere of artistic study.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with Two Country Carts and Figures
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural path with two carts being drawn by horses or mules. The first cart carries two figures, a dog, and travels along a tree-lined path that curves into the distance. Rolling hills with scattered trees can be seen, along with a wide sky. Two birds fly in the top right corner. The brushstrokes are fine and cross-hatched, providing texture to the trees and landscape. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones, creating a nostalgic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with Riders
artworks.description: The image depicts a wooded path with a group of three riders on horseback traveling from left to right. Tall trees dominate the scene, with no visible horizon due to the tree canopy. The brushstrokes are fluid and loose, with a monochromatic color palette of gray and brown. The path curves into the distance within the forest.

artworks.title: The Virgin Supporting the Body of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one male and one female, most of their upper bodies visible. The male figure is in the foreground, leaning left with his head down and supported by the female figure. He has a bearded face, sunken eyes, a crown of thorns, long hair, and visible ribcage. The female figure stands slightly behind and to the right, with a sorrowful expression. She has wide eyes and a hood covering her head. Both are dressed in robes. Above them are two shields with intricate designs. The background is a plain wall with halos around the heads of each figure, suggesting a religious context.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaged in an interaction. The central figure is seated, leaning forward with her head slightly turned. There are individuals around her, some standing. The people have varying hairstyles and are wearing draped clothing. One person sitting at a table holds an object resembling a book or paper. The background features vertical lines suggesting a curtain and architectural elements like columns or arches. The etching uses shading techniques for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures gathered around a central figure. The figures are depicted in flowing garments and attending to the central seated figure, whose posture appears despondent. They are arranged in a semicircle, showcasing a collective sense of attention and concern. Chiaroscuro is used to highlight textures and expressions on the figures' faces. Detailed lines and shading convey movement and energy, with the surroundings kept minimal to focus on the figures.

artworks.title: A View of Savelli near Albano
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with touches of gray and yellow wash
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a rocky hillside leading to a castle-like structure. The drawing shows the elevated view with the horizon high up, blending a hill into the sky. The stone structures include towers, suggesting an old fortress. The sketchy brushstrokes and loose execution give a quick appearance. The color palette is primarily sepia, creating an antique atmosphere, with darker tones for shadows and lighter washes for highlights defining the hills and buildings. Surrounding the castle are dense foliage and rugged terrain.

artworks.title: Waiting
artworks.medium: aquatint and softground etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the head down to her upper torso. She is seated with her head slightly tilted downward and gazing away from the viewer. Her facial features are softly rendered, and her hair is neatly tucked under a head covering or scarf, which is tied under her chin with a bow. She is wearing a patterned attire that appears to have floral or vine-like designs. Her figure is outlined with a combination of solid and faded lines, which blend into the textured background. The background is a mottled, speckled surface that gives a sense of depth, and on the right, it seems to be a part of a patterned curtain or fabric. There are no visible jewelry or distinct objects being held. The overall composition is suggestive of an introspective scene, rendered in a subtle and impressionistic style.

artworks.title: A Native Dance
artworks.description: This is a drawing of seven figures in a ring dance, holding hands in a circular formation. They are dressed in flowing robes with detailed patterns and folds. The scene is set outdoors with trees on the right side and mountains and clouds in the distance. The drawing features intricate linework, particularly in the trees and clothing textures. The clouds and sky add depth to the composition.

artworks.title: The Inside of a Mosque
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a traditional ritual dance scene inside a structured architectural space. The scene depicts an interior of a large hall with high ceilings surrounded by tall windows and adorned with columns. At the center of the hall, figures in flowing garments are engaged in a ritualistic dance, with some twirling with their arms outstretched. Around them, an audience is seated on raised platforms. The detailed line work and intricate depiction of the architectural elements suggest an emphasis on structure and order within the space. The scene has a sense of historical and cultural significance, capturing the moment's solemnity and mysticism. The use of perspective draws the viewer’s eye into the depth of the room, accentuating the central focus on the dancers.

artworks.title: The Seraglio
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior space. The drawing features a room with high ceilings, large windows, and intricate decorations such as geometric and floral designs. The scene depicts several figures, some seated and others standing, wearing traditional attire. Two figures in the foreground appear to be dancing. The setting conveys a sense of grandeur and elegance.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Cave
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cave interior with various elements including a lion and a cross. The composition shows a rocky and textured cave interior. A lion is situated near the cave entrance. There is an altar-like setup with a wooden cross and a lit candle inside the cave, surrounded by stalactites. The drawing is detailed with line work, shading, and texture to convey depth and emotion.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with multiple figures engaged in an event. The central figure appears lifeless, surrounded by others showing expressions of grief or contemplation. The figures are depicted in a classic style with shading and line work. One figure has a halo effect around their head. The background includes draped fabrics and wooden textures. The painting is in the style of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.4 × 11.3 cm (6 1/16 × 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a seated figure, with one arm outstretched towards a tree. The person is positioned in a relaxed manner, leaning against a tree trunk, with one leg bent and the other extended. Their facial features are marked with deep lines, and they have curly hair that falls to their shoulders. The clothing is minimal, with a cloth draped around the waist. They are holding a small circular object in their right hand. Surrounding the person are trees and foliage, emphasizing a natural setting, and a small animal resembling a sheep appears in the foreground near the left side of the scene. The background is sparse with some undulating lines suggesting a landscape.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.1 × 14.1 cm (11 7/16 × 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man holding a large cross with both arms. His body is turned to the side, and he is barefoot. The man has defined facial features, a bushy beard, curly hair, and wears a draped garment that leaves one shoulder exposed. The background has vertical and diagonal lines.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a figure dressed in robes, with their head turned upwards to the left. The person has curly hair, a beard, and is holding a cup with a coiled snake in their left hand. The background consists of linear patterns radiating in rays around the figure.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saints
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Nicolo Vicentino, after Camillo Boccaccino
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures situated beneath a canopy with draped fabric. The image features intricately detailed figures displaying elaborate drapery and expressive gestures, gathered around what appears to be a regal or important scene. The figures exhibit classical-inspired poses with one holding a cylindrical object, possibly a vessel, and others showcasing tender expressions and postures towards a central figure. The use of strong lines and cross-hatching effectively creates a dynamic sense of texture and light throughout the composition.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Travelers
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sepia-toned etching of a fortified town in a rugged landscape with rock formations, a river, and a stone bridge. The viewpoint is elevated, showing two figures on horseback with a dog on a dirt path leading to the city. The city features towers, buildings, and mountains in the background under a sky filled with clouds. The etching has intricate line work, light, shadow, and textures, creating a timeless and grand atmosphere.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.description: This drawing features two older men and a woman near a fountain. The woman is partially covered with fabric, seated in a garden setting. Two men are seen over a lattice, gesturing and engaged in conversation. A sculptural fountain is on the right side of the composition. The scene includes lush foliage and detailed textures.

artworks.title: Saint George Slaying the Dragon
artworks.description: This image shows a knight slaying a dragon. The knight is in elaborate armor and mounted on a horse, thrusting a lance into the dragon. In the background, there is a dense forest with an ancient castle on a hill. The line work is precise and ornate, with swirling clouds above and a patch of barren trees to the left.

artworks.title: Woman Pulling Her Hair
artworks.artist: Marcantonio Raimondi possibly after Francesco Francia
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed on plate mark): 10.6 x 6.1 cm (4 3/16 x 2 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their legs apart, their body slightly turned to the left, and both arms raised to hold their voluminous hair. Their hair falls in curls and waves around their shoulders and face. The person has strong facial features, including a distinct jawline and deep-set eyes. They are dressed in a flowing garment that clings to their form, displaying intricate detailing in its folds and fabric. The outfit appears to be a draped fabric, revealing glimpses of the body's form beneath it. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Head of an Aged Woman
artworks.artist: Johann Friedrich Bause after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Zeitlin and Ver Brugge
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a person's body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is facing slightly to the right with their head turned towards the viewer. They have detailed facial features suggestive of an older age, with pronounced wrinkles and expression lines. Their hair is covered with a cap or tight cloth, and they wear a headscarf that falls around their shoulders. The clothing is dark and draped, giving a somber yet dignified appearance. The background is plain and shadowy, highlighting the person's face and upper body. No accessories or objects are visible.
